title: A Noche Sone — "Build your outfit" dress-up doll
note: Dreamy Y2K store on an underwater pool photo. Cut-out garments surround a photo of the model; drag any piece onto her and it stays where you drop it, like a paper doll. One GSAP Draggable call over cut-out PNGs. Reusable as a drag-around collage of a designer’s pieces.
